job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
Jayce Grayye Consulting and Recruiting are representing a global interior design firm that has become synonymous with elegance, precision, and high-end hospitality environments across Dubai and the Middle East. Known for transforming five-star hotels and destination restaurants into timeless spaces, the firm is now expanding into the U.S. and seeking a Business Development Manager to lead the charge.

The Opportunity:

This is more than a sales role. It’s an invitation to help shape the U.S. presence of a firm trusted by some of the world’s most discerning hoteliers and restaurateurs. You’ll serve as the face of the brand in a new market, meeting with clients, nurturing relationships, and guiding luxury design projects from vision to execution.

You’ll be working directly with leading hotel groups, design studios, and hospitality developers. Each engagement is bespoke, each space a signature. Your ability to connect with decision-makers, understand complex design requirements, and stay hands-on throughout the project lifecycle will be key.

You Bring:

  • Experience selling into luxury hospitality—hotels, resorts, or high-end restaurants
  • A polished, consultative approach with strong commercial acumen
  • Confidence in managing client relationships from initial meeting to final delivery
  • A background in FF&E, bespoke interiors, or hospitality-focused design services
  • Comfort working remotely and traveling for client meetings and industry events

What’s on Offer:

  • The chance to help launch a luxury brand in a major new market
  • A base salary of $80,000 to $100,000 and a strong opportunity for earning high commissions
  • A client portfolio of iconic hotels and upscale restaurant groups
  • A refined, international work culture rooted in design excellence
  • Competitive six-figure earning potential with long-term opportunity
  • Full autonomy, global support, and an invitation to build something lasting

If your network is in luxury hospitality, and you’ve been waiting for a role with vision, aesthetic, and upside, this could be it.

job.title: Health Insurance Closer
job.description:
Jayce Grayye Consulting is searching for Closers to join a powerhouse health insurance brokerage.

A health license is required.

This isn’t a seat for order-takers. Our client is a well-established brokerage with a proven system, a steady stream of inbound leads, and a mission: to simplify healthcare coverage so families get better protection at better prices without the confusion.

As a Closer, you’ll step into a role where your focus is pure performance:

  • Engaging with qualified leads
  • Running consultative conversations that build trust fast
  • Presenting tailored health insurance solutions
  • Closing deals that change lives and drive serious revenue

We’re looking for closers who are:

  • Relentlessly competitive, with the hunger to dominate your numbers
  • Patient and disciplined enough to master the sales cycle
  • Self-motivated, self-starting, and obsessed with improvement
  • Driven not just by commission, but by impact helping families secure peace of mind

Why This Role?

  • High-velocity earning potential: OTE $100K-125K (top performers push beyond this)
  • Steady inbound lead flow no cold calling, just pure closing
  • Strong support system, back-end infrastructure, training, and winning culture
  • The chance to put your skills to work in a meaningful industry where your close = someone’s future security

What This Job Entails

  • Commission-only + Monthly residuals.
  • High activity, high reward: Consistently making 100+ calls per day to engage with a steady stream of leads.
  • Elite closing standards: Maintaining a 30%+ close rate on connected leads.
  • Revenue focus: Driving $3,500+ in weekly policy volume.
  • End-to-end sales: Facilitating the full closing process from first call to signed policy.
  • Crushing quotas: Meeting and exceeding aggressive sales targets—no excuses.
  • Pipeline ownership: Proactively building, managing, and developing new opportunities.
  • High-octane culture: If you’re not a go-getter, this environment will chew you up.
  • No babysitting: You’ll have freedom, but with that comes accountability.
  • Performance-driven seat: If you can’t handle the heat, don’t apply.

Requirements (What It Takes to Win Here)

This role isn’t for average reps. We’re looking for proven closers who can step into a high-performance environment.

  • Proven sales track record: At least 1+ year of closing experience.
  • Elite communicator: You know how to connect, persuade, and negotiate with clarity and confidence.
  • Closer’s mindset: Relentlessly driven to exceed targets, dominate the leaderboard, and win.
  • Problem-solver under pressure: You can think fast, pivot mid-conversation, and solve live objections without breaking stride.
  • Availability & flexibility: When opportunity knocks, morning, evening, or weekend, you pick up the phone.
  • Coachability & growth-hunger: You thrive on feedback, love training, and push yourself to level up every single day.
  • Empathy + edge: You genuinely care about people, but you never lose sight of the close.
  • Independent self-starter: You own your calendar, your pipeline, and your outcomes, no handholding required.
  • Team player: Willing to collaborate, support your peers, and contribute to a culture of winning.
  • Dependable & accountable: You show up every day ready to execute, because you know your team and your clients are counting on you.

Who This Role Is Not For

  • Reps who need handholding
  • People who avoid the phone after 5 PM
  • Anyone without proof of crushing quotas and driving real revenue

Ready to Close?

If you’re among those who thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment and you’re ready to step into a role that rewards you for every ounce of skill, apply today.

Job Type

Full-Time, Residual Plus Commission, Sales, Insurance Industry, USD, Remote Inside Sales, 1099.

job.title: Partnership Consultant
job.description:
Partnership Consultant

Behavioral Health & Hospital Partnerships

About Our Client

Jayce Grayye Consulting is representing a mission-driven organization that has spent nearly three decades helping students continue their education while receiving treatment in hospitals and behavioral health facilities.

Their programs ensure academic continuity for school-aged patients, helping them maintain educational progress during treatment and successfully transition back into traditional classroom environments. As demand continues to grow, they are expanding their Business Development team to support strategic partnerships across the healthcare landscape.

The Opportunity

This is a true full-cycle sales role responsible for driving new partnerships with behavioral health facilities, psychiatric hospitals, healthcare systems, and treatment centers throughout the United States.

You'll be responsible for identifying opportunities, prospecting executive decision-makers, developing customized solutions, negotiating agreements, and closing new business. This role offers direct exposure to executive leadership and provides the autonomy to build and manage your own territory.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys hunting for new business, thrives in consultative sales environments, and is comfortable engaging C-suite healthcare executives.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Prospect and develop a designated territory

  • Generate new business opportunities through outbound outreach

  • Build relationships with hospital executives and behavioral health leaders

  • Create customized educational solutions for prospective partners

  • Conduct discovery meetings and needs assessments

  • Deliver presentations and service proposals

  • Forecast pipeline activity and revenue opportunities

  • Negotiate contracts and partnership agreements

  • Manage opportunities through the entire sales cycle

  • Collaborate with leadership to achieve growth objectives

What Success Looks Like

Successful candidates will:

  • Consistently generate qualified opportunities through self-sourced prospecting

  • Build executive-level relationships within healthcare organizations

  • Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities

  • Navigate complex healthcare buying processes

  • Close six-figure partnership agreements

  • Become a trusted advisor to behavioral health and hospital leadership teams

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $70,000 - $75,000

On-Target Earnings (OTE):

  • Year 1: $125,000+

  • Year 3: $234,000+

This role offers a highly rewarding commission structure tied directly to revenue generated from closed partnerships. Top performers who consistently build pipeline, create executive-level relationships, and close strategic healthcare partnerships will have a clear path to significant earnings growth.

Benefits Include

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

  • 401(k)

  • Employer-Sponsored Life Insurance

  • Tuition Reimbursement Assistance

  • Paid Family Leave

  • 15 Personal Days

  • 5 Sick Days

  • 11 Paid Holidays

Ideal Background

We're seeking a high-performing business development professional with a proven ability to prospect, build relationships, and close complex deals.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree

  • 4-5+ years of successful B2B sales experience

  • Proven track record selling six-figure solutions

  • Experience prospecting via phone, email, video, and in-person meetings

  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills

  • Ability to manage the entire sales cycle independently

  • Comfortable discussing and demonstrating technology-enabled solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling into hospitals, healthcare systems, or behavioral health organizations

  • Prior behavioral health business development experience

  • Experience selling services to executive-level healthcare decision-makers

  • Strong understanding of healthcare buying processes and stakeholder management

Why Top Performers Are Interested

  • Clear earnings trajectory from $125K+ OTE in Year 1 to $234K+ OTE by Year 3

  • Full ownership of your territory and sales process

  • Direct access to executive leadership

  • Ability to make a meaningful impact on students, families, and healthcare organizations

  • Remote flexibility with national territory exposure

  • Opportunity to build a long-term career within a growing organization

  • Sell a differentiated solution with a compelling mission and strong market demand

Location & Travel

  • Remote-based position

  • Approximately 40% travel required

  • National territory responsibility

If you're a motivated sales professional who enjoys building relationships, creating solutions, and closing meaningful partnerships, we'd love to speak with you.

job.title: Sales Representive
job.description:
Jayce Grayye Consulting and Recruiting is recruiting a Sales Representative for our client who manufactures portable sawmills that have been in families for decades: passed down, relied on, built into the fabric of working land. When you close a deal here, you're not selling a product. You're setting someone up with the tools to mill their own lumber, build their own structures, and own their outcomes.

This role is for a driven, coachable seller who thrives in a high-volume environment, knows how to work a pipeline, and genuinely enjoys connecting with people who build things with their hands.

What you'll do:

Drive the pipeline

Manage $1–3M in open quotes at any time. Use parallel dialling and disciplined follow-up to convert inbound and outbound leads.

Become the expert

Learn the full product lineup: sawmills, attachments, and competing equipment — and consult buyers with genuine authority.

Build lasting relationships

Engage new and existing customers by phone, email, text, and in person. Up-sell accessories as their needs evolve.

Own your results

Hit KPIs for customer service and revenue. Track your activity, self-report honestly, and always look for ways to improve.

You'll also represent the company at select tradeshows and make occasional visits to the Canadian head office for training. Some mid-year statutory holidays may be required (lieu days given).

What we're looking for:

Proven track record in sales — you know how to open, nurture, and close

Comfortable with high-volume phone activity and parallel dialing tools

Interest in or background with equipment, power tools, or the land/forestry space — or genuinely eager to learn it

Self-motivated and disciplined — you don't need a manager standing over you to pick up the phone

A communicator who adapts — professional and responsive across phone, text, email, and face to face.

Why this role:

Our client has been manufacturing portable sawmills for over 50 years. Their customers are landowners, farmers, homesteaders, and builders: people who invest in quality and keep equipment for life. That means your pipeline stays warm, referrals are real, and the product sells itself when you know it well. You'll earn a competitive salary of $60,000 - $65,000 and an OTE between $90,000 and $110,000.

If you want a role where your effort directly maps to your income, and where what you're selling genuinely matters to the people buying it, this is it.

job.title: Sales Closer
job.description:
Jayce Grayye Consulting is partnering with a leading wholesale diamond firm in New York City to hire an experienced, high-caliber Jewelry Wholesale Business Development Executive.

Our client is a long-established, nationally trusted diamond wholesaler supplying premium loose diamonds and fine diamonds to retailers, jewelers, and luxury buyers across the US. With over three decades in the market, they are expanding their NYC presence on 47th Street and need someone who already knows the terrain.

If you’ve spent years inside diamond wholesale, understand pricing, margins, inventory movement, and client psychology, and are ready to operate at a higher commercial level, this role is built for you.

 

The Role

You’ll manage and grow high-value retail and trade relationships, working with serious buyers and meaningful deal sizes. This is a consultative, relationship-driven sales role where credibility, speed, and judgment matter as much as closing ability.

You will own the full sales cycle, from qualified inbound and existing accounts through negotiation, fulfilment, and long-term client retention.

 

Compensation & Structure

• Onsite, full-time role in NYC

• Base salary: $80,000–$140,000 (depending on experience)

• OTE: $150,000–$200,000+

• Uncapped commission structure

• W2 position with long-term growth and earning upside

• Work within one of the most respected names in diamond wholesale

 

What You’ll Be Responsible For

• Managing and converting qualified inbound leads and established accounts

• Building long-term, repeat relationships with retailers and trade clients

• Advising clients on stone selection, pricing strategy, and market conditions

• Negotiating and closing high-value, high-margin diamond transactions

• Maintaining deep knowledge of inventory, grading, pricing, and trends

• Proactively growing your book of business and pipeline

• Collaborating closely with internal sourcing, operations, and leadership teams

• Representing the business at trade shows and industry events

• Consistently hitting and exceeding revenue targets

 

What You Bring:

• Minimum 3 years of experience in jewelry wholesale sales

• Proven success closing high-ticket deals in a fast-paced luxury environment

• Strong understanding of diamond grading, pricing, and wholesale dynamics

• Exceptional negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills

• Confidence operating with sophisticated buyers and demanding clients

• CRM fluency and strong organizational discipline

• Self-directed, commercially sharp, and performance-driven mindset

• Flexibility to support clients outside standard business hours

• Professional presence and credibility in the NYC diamond market

 

Why This Role Is Different

This is a step up from regional or lower-volume markets. You’ll be operating across the United States with larger deals, sharper clients, and real influence over revenue. The expectations are higher, but so is the upside, autonomy, and long-term career value.

 

Ready to Move Up-Market?

If you’re already successful in jewelry wholesale and want bigger deals, stronger backing, and a platform worthy of your experience, apply now.
